label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter name flows directly into the LDAP filter string via concatenation ('uid='+bar+')'. The helper function ThingFactory creates a factory instance whose doSomething method returns the passed parameter unchanged. ESAPI.encodeForHTML is applied to attribute values retrieved from the search results, not to the filter itself which is used in idc.search(). Therefore, unencoded user input reaches the LDAP engine enabling injection.

evidence.note: Parameter name extracted from request and stored in variable param
Param flows through doSomething which returns it unchanged as bar
Filter constructed with unsanitized bar concatenated into LDAP query string
Unsanitized filter passed to idc.search() allowing LDAP injection
